output.summary: The claim was denied because the MRI was performed out‑of‑network and was not an emergency. Without emergency documentation the denial remains in effect.

items.text: Obtain an emergency attestation signed by the attending physician confirming the MRI was performed as an emergency.
Provide the discharge summary from the facility showing the emergency nature of the visit.
Precedent F-OON-ER does not apply because it only overturns denials for emergency services, and this claim is for a non‑emergency MRI.
The claim is blocked by the EMERGENCY_REQUIRED gate; without proof of an emergency, there is no basis to appeal.
Record the denial decision and notify the policyholder that the claim remains denied under clause C-2025-OON-EMERGENCY.
